name: travel-guidebook
title_zh: 从踩点笔记到排版成册，一趟生成旅行指南 PDF
tagline_zh: 把行程调研做成能打印的 PDF 路书：暖色纸底、衬线体、Tabler 图标和内联 SVG 装饰，靠排版撑设计感。
tagline_en: Turns trip research into a printable PDF guidebook — warm parchment ground, serif type, Tabler icons and inline SVG ornament. The design comes from typesetting, not from generated pictures.
desc_en: AI agent skill that generates beautifully typeset travel guidebook PDFs —  from research to print, powered by parallel agents and Amap MCP.
why_zh: 「零 AI 插图」是硬规则不是风格偏好——旅行册子最容易骗人的就是一张不存在的风景图。
why_en: Zero AI illustration is a hard rule rather than a taste preference. The easiest way for a travel book to lie is a landscape photo of a place that does not exist.
limit_zh: 要 Node.js 和 Playwright 才能导 PDF，装环境有成本。深度调研阶段会并行开五个 agent，很吃 token。成品是印刷导向的长文档，不是手机上随时改的行程 App。只做排版和成书，订票订房都不管。
limit_en: Needs Node.js and Playwright to export the PDF. The research stage fans out five parallel agents and burns tokens. The output is a print-oriented document, not a phone itinerary you tweak on the road. It typesets and binds; it books nothing.
title_en: Turn scattered travel notes into a print-ready guidebook PDF
